intention: Dashboard history charts are driven by start/end calendar-date range params (not a days count) with a fixed date axis on both charts, a remove-Refresh hygiene change, and a project-wide start/end-date-filter convention for gateway HTTP endpoints.
request: MAG-7 — Date Filters. (1) Remove the Refresh button/action. (2) The history API ui/dashboard/history?days=6 should use start/end date filters instead of a days count — if either odometer or battery history is missing a record on a given day the count-based read creates a mismatch between the dates on the two graphs (odometer 08-01 vs battery 08-02) — and set a project-wide rule that date filters on APIs are handled by start/end date filters. Linear: https://linear.app/magus-monitor/issue/MAG-7/date-filters

decisions.decision: Add SnapshotsByVehicleBetween(start,end) to telemetry.Reader (roadmap) instead of clamping end in the gateway (single-module)
decisions.why: The convention covers the internal Go read port too, not only the HTTP surface; bounded-window read as a first-class telemetry method.

decisions.decision: HTTP date params: ?start=YYYY-MM-DD&end=YYYY-MM-DD, end inclusive, default 6-day window, 400 on malformed/end<start/end>today, hard cap 90 days
decisions.why: Calendar-day params (not datetime) avoid midnight mis-bucketing; the cap protects the read-heavy hot path from unbounded range scans.

decisions.decision: Keep the 6/14/30 preset selector, server-render absolute start/end hrefs (no date-range picker, no client JS)
decisions.why: Identical UX with no JS; a custom calendar picker is out of ticket scope and breaks the no-client-JS gateway invariant.

decisions.decision: Fixed [start..end] date axis (1 bar/day, missing days = empty labeled slots), 1-day lookback for the first odometer delta only
decisions.why: Removes the per-snapshot-shift offset between odometer (days+1 pts) and battery (days pts) — the root cause of the MAG-7 08-01/08-02 mismatch; port stays a clean Between(start,end), lookback is a gateway concern.

decisions.decision: Remove only the dashboard page Refresh button (pages/dashboard.templ), keep the charges-list Refresh
decisions.why: Dashboard Refresh is a vestigial page reload already superseded by htmx self-refresh; charges-list Refresh is a different feature out of ticket scope.

decisions.decision: Convention doc canonical home: internal/gateway/AGENTS.md + one-line pointer in ai/go-conventions.md (not CLAUDE.md, not module-only)
decisions.why: The module owning all HTTP endpoints owns the convention and is already in the gateway worker doc-pack; the go-conventions pointer keeps it discoverable cross-cutting without a CLAUDE.md context cost.
